summary: Elevate your real estate expertise with our principles training course. Learn the essential concepts and practical skills to thrive in the market!
lede: Real estate principles show how market conditions, valuation, ownership, and financing affect property transactions. For people working in brokerage, property administration, leasing, valuation support, or investment analysis, the course provides a practical foundation for pricing properties and reviewing transactions. Learners practice comparing sales, preparing valuation worksheets, checking title and disclosure risks, and comparing financing using loan-to-value and debt service coverage calculations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for you if you work in brokerage, property administration, leasing, valuation support, investment analysis, or development support and need a practical foundation in real estate principles. Real Estate Agents handling listings, buyer queries, and market pricing. Real Estate Brokers overseeing transaction quality and agency compliance. Property Managers managing occupancy, rent rolls, and tenant records. Leasing Coordinators preparing lease documents and renewal comparisons. Investment Analysts reviewing property pricing and income potential. Development Assistants supporting site feasibility and planning checks. Asset Management Analysts tracking portfolio performance and reporting. Commercial Property Consultants advising owners on market positioning. Transaction Coordinators managing documents, disclosures, and closing steps. Mortgage Advisors evaluating affordability, leverage, and repayment structures.
prerequisites: Participants should bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets installed and a willingness to work through property examples, valuation calculations, and transaction documents. A calculator is useful, and prior exposure to listing sheets, lease summaries, or mortgage terms will help you move faster through the exercises.
